title: YOUR TEAMMATE SEES YOUR BUILD
why: His answer of 2026-10-08: everyone sees the build, the way they see your outfit and hair. The look each player sends now carries the build, a bad id is dropped like any other, and the teammate is drawn in the build sent, on the Undercroft floor and in a raid, in two windows on one PC or online.
now: In co-op your teammate sees your build, and you see theirs.
